summary: Phase 18 Material Requisition + Budget Alert testing completed. Backend 100% functional (21/21 tests passed). Frontend all major features working correctly with minor UI polish issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog overlay blocks clicks on 'Setujui' button inside detail modal when trying to approve from detail view
ui_bugs.workaround: Approve button works correctly from the main list view (outside dialog). Backend API works perfectly. This is a UI polish issue with dialog overlay z-index.
